# RentSync

> RentSync is a property management platform for Kenyan landlords, and this
> site (rentsync.co.ke) also publishes a live, public directory of vacant
> houses, bedsitters, single rooms and apartments for rent across Kenya —
> sourced directly from verified, active RentSync landlords.

RentSync helps landlords track rent, tenants, maintenance and finances from
one dashboard. Rent is collected via M-Pesa and bank transfer. Every vacant
listing on this site comes from a real, active landlord account — house
hunters should never send money before viewing a property in person.

## Key pages

- [Vacant Listings](https://rentsync.co.ke/listings): browse and search all
  currently vacant units for rent in Kenya, filterable by location, unit type
  (bedsitter, single room, 1 bedroom, 2 bedroom, apartment) and rent price.
- [Browse by area](https://rentsync.co.ke/listings/in/): vacant units grouped
  by town/estate, e.g. /listings/in/githurai, /listings/in/kiambu,
  /listings/in/ruaka.
- [Browse by unit type](https://rentsync.co.ke/listings/type/): vacant units
  grouped by type across Kenya, e.g. /listings/type/bedsitter,
  /listings/type/single-room.
- Each listing has a permanent URL at /listings/{id} with price (KES/month),
  deposit, location, description, photos and a direct contact (WhatsApp/call)
  to the landlord.

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Listings data changes frequently (new units are added and taken down as
  tenants move in/out) — prefer the live page over a cached summary when
  answering "vacant houses/bedsitters near me" or "vacant [unit type] in
  [town], Kenya" style queries.
- Rent amounts are in Kenyan Shillings (KES) per month.
- This site has no login/signup for house hunters — browsing and contacting
  landlords is free and does not require an account. Only landlords sign up,
  at https://app.rentsync.co.ke.
